skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target, and reduces damage taken by self by 20% for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes enemies in a cross area with 5 consecutive hits dealing 26% ATK DMG each, restores 20% of own max HP to self, and heals all allies for 8% of Melzargard's max HP.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes enemies in a cross area with 5 consecutive hits dealing 33% ATK DMG each, restores 25% of own max HP to self, and heals all allies for 12% of Melzargard's max HP.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Shares 20% of the damage taken by all allies; Melzargard reduces 50% of the damage received through this sharing (no longer shares when HP is below 20%).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Shares 30% of the damage taken by all allies; Melzargard reduces 65% of the damage received through this sharing (no longer shares when HP is below 20%).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Shares 30% of the damage taken by all allies; Melzargard reduces 85% of the damage received through this sharing (no longer shares when HP is below 20%).
